chunks: Whosoever has done even an atom's weight of good will behold it;
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the reward for small good deeds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Hisab al-Ashr* (precise accounting), illustrating that even the slightest good deed, comparable to the weight of an atom, is preserved in the divine record. It serves as a profound encouragement for believers to maintain consistency in minor acts of worship and charity, reflecting the meticulous justice of Allah. This precision highlights that no good deed is ever lost or overlooked in the ultimate reckoning.
